notes.title: Moonbase Down: Prelude to War | Invasion of Sol
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32853264/35741652422b426c012ab6a4401d2fba2deb7e59.png[/img]

Dear Gamers,

We been polishing and updating MBD version 1.2, and it's more fun than ever before...

With that done: [b]Arcade & Unlimited[/b] mode are ready for the main store after years of Early Access. Thank you to players who got the game early and gave us fantastic feedback! 

We decided the slow development of Sandbox Mode makes more sense as its own separate game project called: [b]Moonbase Down: Invasion of Sol[/b]. Which is now listed separately on Steam as DLC but may also be released as a standalone game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/870590/Moonbase_Down/
[h3][b]1.2.0 Features  [/b][/h3][list]
[*] Graphics 2X Bigger (with scrolling maps)
[*] Line of Sight: Aliens are more sneaky
[*] Updated targeting system
[*] Pulse Rifle 2X damage
[*] Stasis Mines: Longer Force Cage
[*] Faster Run Speed for PC and some Xenomorph
[*] PC level boosts ammo per clip: Rewards higher level characters
[*] Reduced Impregnation Penalty: Batteries collected +100% power drop with corpse
[*] Crew Logs Window
[*] Greatly Enhanced Space Dragon A.I.
[*] Space Dragons now regenerate while sleeping
[*] Spawns some logs on downed crew members
[*] Crew Logs should correctly spawn procedurally in all rooms & floors
[*] Pause button moved to [Spacebar]
[*] Should fix several instances of getting stuck on maps at the entrance
[*] Adds a chance to find missed Crew Logs in Lockers
[*] Fixes Stasis Field effect
[*] Should fix (old) downed crew targeting bug
[*] Fixes missing text and timing issues in the Introduction
[*] Stasis Cages now effect unhatched Eggs 
[*] Increased chance of finding skipped logs in lockers on the next floor
[*] Decreased the decay time of egg husks 
[*] Space Dragon "flipping" should be reduced
[*] Fixes Jonesy sometimes going missing/ghostly after winning 10-floors 
[*] Mines no longer persist across floors
[*] Moonbase Down Report Achievement: Now correctly triggered once Crew Log window is full 
[*] Friends with Jonesy Leaderboard!
[*] Enhanced Visuals & FX
[*] 1.2.0: Hard Mode: adds 'mysterious' layer of difficulty after surviving 10-Floors 
[*] 1.2.0: Raises the character level cap to 30
[*] DLC: Sandbox Mode under development:[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1909050/Moonbase_Down_Invasion_of_Sol/

We hope you will make your mark on the [b]Moonbase Down Steam Leaderboards[/b] and leave us an excellent Steam review! Recommended reviews are the best way to support future MBD development.

For those seeking even more adventure, MBD will soon be bundled with our recently updated high seas action RPG, which also features strange monsters and a dreaded undersea realm:

[h3][b]Bewildering Beasts Bundle  [/b][/h3]
[i]...Coming soon...[/i]

Thank you very much,
[b]AdventRPG[/b]
GM-X

[i]Please report any problems or bugs in [b]Steam Discussions[/b]. We fix most reported issues within 2-buisness days.[/i]

notes.title: Update Log: 1.2.0
notes.content:
We been enhancing the game and polishing the experience daily as we receive play testing feedback. Check this log for the many small changes made that make the game more fun:
[list]
[*] Spawns some logs on downed crew members
[*] Crew Logs interface - for later reading
[*] Crew Logs should correctly spawn procedurally in all rooms & floors (not 100% certain)
[*] Pause button moved to [Spacebar]
[*] Should fix several instances of getting stuck on maps at the entrance: Press the "Insert" key if you are stuck to generate an error code, take a screenshot, and let us know so we can fix it
[*] Adds a chance to find missed Crew Logs in Lockers
[*] Enhances all Xenomorph A.I.
[*] Greatly Enhanced Space Dragon A.I.
[*] Space Dragons now regenerate while sleeping
[*] Space Dragon "flipping" should be reduced
[*] Fixes spacing in the "Continue Game" window
[*] Should fix instances of the camera starting in darkened areas of the map
[*] Reduced number of starting Stasis Mines to X1
[*] Fixes Stasis Field effect
[*] Should fix (old) downed crew targeting bug
[*] Fixes missing text and timing issues in the Introduction
[*] Stasis Cages now effect unhatched Eggs 
[*] Increased chance of finding skipped logs in lockers on the next floor
[*] Decreased the decay time of egg husks 
[*] Should finally fix getting stuck at the start of any floor
[*] Friends with Jonesy Leaderboard is now live
[*] Fixes Jonesy sometimes going missing/ghostly after winning 10-floors 
[*] Mines no longer persist across floors
[*] Moonbase Down Report Achievement: Now correctly triggered once Crew Log window is full 
[*] Raises the character level cap to 30
[*] Hard Mode: adds 'mysterious' layer of difficulty after surviving 10-Floors 
[/list]
Please report any bugs or great suggestions in Steam discussions.

notes.title: Moonbase Down 1.2.0: Prelude to War
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32853264/c9733310d62f2f703b74152ee24de7612b0bfdb0.png[/img]

Hello Xenomorph & RL fans!

After an extended period without updates, Moonbase Down is back with a large set of feature enhancements.

We put a new layer of love into arcade mode in preparation for the "long time coming soon" sandbox mode. Since sandbox mode will utilize the same combat system for certain parts of the adventure, we wanted to make sure that arcade mode is as fun as possible. 

Overall, the pace is faster and players have better odds of surviving to collect all 10 crew logs. The graphics are easier to look at and Xenomorph are easier to target and evade. 

[h3][b]1.2.0 New Features  [/b][/h3][list]
[b][*] Graphics are now 2X larger (with scrolling maps)
[*] Line of Sight: Aliens are more sneaky
[*] Updated targeting system
[*] Pulse Rifle 2X damage
[*] Stasis Mines: Longer Force Cage
[*] Faster Run Speed for PC and some Xenomorph
[*] PC level boosts ammo per clip: Rewards higher level characters
[*] Reduced Impregnation Penalty: Batteries collected +100% power drop with corpse
[*] Crew Logs Window
[*] Enhances A.I. and Xenomorph Aggression
[*] Greatly Enhanced Space Dragon A.I.
[*] Space Dragons now regenerate while sleeping
[*] Steam Leaderboards are now live
[*] 1.2.0: Hard Mode: adds 'mysterious' layer of difficulty after surviving 10-Floors 
[*] 1.2.0: Raises the character level cap to 30
[*] Enhanced Visuals & FX[/b][/list]
If you encounter any problems or have a great suggestion, contact us on discussions and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

And remember, playing MBD in the day-time is a form of cheating.

Thank you so much,

[b]AdventRPG
GM-X[/b]
ːMars2030ː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/870590/Moonbase_Down/

notes.title: Moonbase Down: Released & Update #1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32853264/0b4004af44ad68441d436fe75cf9a4f687ca2f15.png[/img]

[h1][b]Turn down the lights... and Welcome to the Cruel World of Moonbase Down. [/b][/h1]

Moonbase Down Arcade mode is up and running smoothly now, and with that Early Access begins!

If you encounter any bugs or problems while playing, let us know ASAP in comments (or Discussions). We will hot fix any issue you report within 24-hours, if we are able to find it. 

[h1][b]Beyond MBD 1.0 [/b][/h1]

This is only the beginning for Moonbase Down! Features will be added to Arcade mode over time. Once Sandbox mode is deep enough to be fun, it will also be released and updated for a long time to come.   

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32853264/a1ec99ac0f36d49c0117b3965bb637f96cc030b7.png[/img] 

[h1][b]What modes do I get right now when I buy Moonbase Down? [/b][/h1]
Arcade mode and Unlimited mode, with Steam Leaderboards.

[h1][b]Is Arcade / Unlimited Mode a finished game? [/b][/h1]
Yes, you are getting a full featured arcade game right now. But, we plan to add even more to arcade mode and roll out sandbox mode through updates or DLC.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32853264/dc4fdacb6e97cdef98019a6025073abcc2e2dedd.png[/img]

[h1][b]What is Sandbox Mode? [/b][/h1]
Moonbase Down sandbox mode will take the survival struggle to the surface of the Moon and inner solar system. Currently under development.   

[h1][b]When will Sandbox Mode be released? [/b][/h1]
We do not have a date for the first release. The plan is now to have Sandbox Mode release by late 2023.

[h1][b]Moonbase Down 1.0.96 is released [10/29/18] [/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Stasis Mines x5 - Player now gets 5x mines when first grabbing them
[*] Added: Class Leaderboards - which key off the number of logs found
[/list]
Please let us know in Discussions if you encounter any problems whatsoever. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/870590/Moonbase_Down/

Thank you so much!
AdventRPG
GM-X
